reasons: narrow: The original claim minimizes the realized latent prognostic sums before averaging. With four units, uniform covariates, zero prognostic score, and independent nondegenerate centered prognostic sums, fixed consecutive online pairing has positive expected variance regret against that latent-outcome oracle while the score-cost right side is zero. Moving the latent-outcome expectation inside each matching criterion restricts the oracle to covariate information and yields the exact proved identity.

narrow: A constant conditional prognostic score makes the score regret zero but does not make regret against an oracle that sees realized latent prognostic sums zero. The corrected conclusion uses precisely the covariate prognostic oracle in the narrowed causal-regret proposition.
